title: Event envelope
description: Every domain event is wrapped in this. The envelope is what makes ADR-001's 'in-process bus now, real queue later' painless: the transport changes, the payload shape does not.

eventId.description: Unique per emission. Consumers use it to detect redelivery — River may deliver a job more than once, so handlers must be idempotent.

eventType.description: {module}.{aggregate}.{event}.v{n}. The version suffix means a breaking payload change ships as .v2 ALONGSIDE .v1 rather than mutating a contract consumers already depend on.

occurredAt.description: When the fact became true — not when it was published. A retried publish keeps the original time; otherwise replaying a queue rewrites history.

correlationId.description: The originating HTTP request. Once the worker is a separate process this is the only thing tying 'the user submitted a scan' to 'the worker failed' across two sets of logs (NFR-9).

causationId.description: The eventId that caused this one. Correlation says which request; causation says which event. Together they reconstruct a chain rather than a pile.
